sdks.title: LayerFS
sdks.description: Projects, Branches, Commits, files, Sandboxes and Workspaces through the pinned LayerFS CLI. The scoped JavaScript compatibility facade delegates to the same CLI adapter. Every call names <store>/<project>; LAYERFS_HOME and LAYERFS_CONNECT_CLI are explicit.

calls.name: project.init
calls.description: import a host folder as a new project into an existing Store

calls.name: project.list
calls.description: every project in the home, or one Store's

calls.name: project.get
calls.description: a project's record: its Store, kind and machine

calls.name: project.stats
calls.description: entry counts of one pinned saved tree

calls.name: project.export
calls.description: export a project's snapshot from its Store to a local folder

calls.name: project.remove
